resources.string: Programmers create software and technology that make life easier and more connected.
Cybersecurity engineers protect computer systems and networks from cyber threats. They help keep data safe by preventing attacks and securing digital information.
Software engineers design, develop, and maintain software applications. They use programming skills to create efficient solutions that help people and businesses solve problems.
Web developers create and maintain websites to ensure they are functional, user-friendly, and visually appealing. They use programming languages to build the modern web.
